{"@context":"http://schema.org/","@id":"/en/products/maison-francis-kurkdjian-paris-baccarat-rouge-540-extrait-de-parfum#product","@type":"ProductGroup","brand":{"@type":"Brand","name":"Maison Francis Kurkdjian Paris"},"category":"","description":"Shared values, expertise, creativity and excellence come together in the collaboration between Maison Francis Kurkdjian and Baccarat, who are now expanding their cooperation, which began in 2014, with the Rouge 540 anniversary fragrance. The original eau de parfum Baccarat Rouge 540, the signature fragrance of Baccarat Crystal, is now available in a new form: as an extrait de parfum.
An intense red colour!
Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum enhances the power and radiance of the three main fragrance components that make up the eau de parfum, without distorting the original inspiration.
The result of master craftsmanship and many years of experience, this extrait de parfum is the crowning glory of Francis Kurkdjian's previous creations.
The bottle plays with the light - for the first time in red - like a stunning red evening gown reminiscent of the legendary Baccarat red.
